title: 国家人工智能产业综合标准化体系建设指南（2024版）(工信部联科〔2024〕113号 / MIIT Guidelines for Construction of National AI Industry Comprehensive Standardization System)

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), and Standardization Administration of China (SAC)
covered_actors: AI standardization technical organizations and standardization research institutions (人工智能领域标准化技术组织、标准化研究机构)
Enterprises across the AI industry chain spanning foundational, framework, model, and application layers (人工智能全产业链大中小企业)
Industry associations, universities, research institutes, and national technical standard innovation bases (行业协会、高校、研究机构、国家技术标准创新基地)

evidence.quote_en: By 2026, alignment between standards and industrial sci-tech innovation will continuously improve, with more than 50 newly formulated national and industry standards accelerating the formation of a standard system guiding high-quality AI industry development. Over 1,000 enterprises will conduct standard outreach and implementation, making standards more effective in serving enterprise innovation, and China will participate in formulating over 20 international standards to promote the global development of the AI industry.

enforcement_authorities: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
AI standardization technical organizations and industry associations (人工智能领域标准化技术组织、行业协会)
compliance_deadlines: By 2026: Newly formulate 50+ national and industry AI standards, engage over 1,000 enterprises in standard outreach and implementation, and participate in formulating 20+ international standards
policy_extraction.penalties_summary: None specified. The guidelines serve as a national AI standardization roadmap implemented through voluntary outreach, training, and enterprise benchmarking rather than coercive sanctions or monetary penalties.
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Jointly issued under Document MIIT-Lian-Ke [2024] No. 113 (2024 Edition) by MIIT, CAC, NDRC, and SAC. Establishes a seven-pillar national AI industry standardization architecture covering foundational common standards, foundational support (data, chips, sensors, compute centers, frameworks), key technologies (including large models, AI agents, and embodied intelligence), smart products/services, new industrialization, sector applications, and safety/governance. Operative standard topics are coded as aspirational because the document sets a 2026 standard-development roadmap rather than imposing standalone operational compliance procedures.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The 2024 National AI Industry Comprehensive Standardization System Construction Guidelines are dominantly framed around economic competitiveness, positioning AI as a strategic engine for new quality productive forces, industrial upgrading, deep integration with the real economy, and building a manufacturing and digital power while seizing first-mover global industrial advantage and shaping international standards. Innovation enablement is a major secondary frame, emphasizing innovation-driven conversion of R&D breakthroughs into technical standards, market-oriented enterprise adoption across large and small firms, and broad AI-plus industry empowerment. Consumer and public safety serves as a supporting secondary frame through its call to balance high-quality development with high-level security and to establish full-lifecycle AI safety, content labeling, reliability, and ethical risk-assessment standards.

evidence_spans.quote:
人工智能是引领新一轮科技革命和产业变革的基础性
和战略性技术，正成为发展新质生产力的重要引擎，加速和
实体经济深度融合，全面赋能新型工业化，深刻改变工业生
产模式和经济发展形态，将对加快建设制造强国、网络强国
和数字中国发挥重要的支撑作用。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Artificial intelligence is a foundational and strategic technology leading a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation. It is becoming an important engine for developing new quality productive forces, accelerating deep integration with the real economy, comprehensively empowering new industrialization, profoundly reshaping industrial production models and economic forms, and playing a vital supporting role in accelerating the building of a Manufacturing Power, Cyber Power, and Digital China.

evidence_spans.quote:
统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，加快
赋能新型工业化，以抢抓人工智能产业发展先机为目标，完
善人工智能标准工作顶层设计，强化全产业链标准工作协
同，统筹推进标准的研究、制定、实施和国际化，为推动我
国人工智能产业高质量发展提供坚实的技术支撑。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Coordinate high-quality development and high-level security, accelerate the empowerment of new industrialization, take seizing the first-mover initiative in AI industry development as the goal, improve top-level design for AI standardization, strengthen standard synergy across the entire industrial chain, and comprehensively advance standard research, formulation, implementation, and internationalization to provide solid technical support for promoting high-quality development of China's AI industry.

evidence_spans.quote:
坚持创新驱动。优化产业科技创新与标准化联动机制，
加快人工智能领域关键共性技术研究，推动先进适用的科技
创新成果高效转化成标准。
坚持应用牵引。坚持企业主体、市场导向，面向行业应
用需求，强化创新成果迭代和应用场景构建，协同推进人工

智能与重点行业融合应用。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Adhere to innovation-driven development. Optimize the linkage mechanism between industrial sci-tech innovation and standardization, accelerate research on key common technologies in AI, and promote the efficient transformation of advanced and applicable technological achievements into standards. Adhere to application-pulled development. Uphold enterprises as the main body and market orientation, address industry application needs, strengthen iteration of innovation outcomes and scenario building, and collaboratively advance integrated AI applications in key industries.

evidence_spans.quote:
加快构建满足人工智能产业高质量发展和“人工智能+”高水
平赋能需求的标准体系，夯实标准对推动技术进步、促进企
业发展、引领产业升级、保障产业安全的支撑作用，更好推
进人工智能赋能新型工业化，特制定本指南。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Accelerate the construction of a standard system that meets the needs of high-quality AI industry development and high-level 'AI+' empowerment, consolidate the supporting role of standards in driving technological progress, promoting enterprise development, leading industrial upgrading, and safeguarding industrial security, and better advance AI-empowered new industrialization; these Guidelines are hereby formulated.
